answer: A work-history attestation graph resists sybils by making reputation earned, not claimed: a new identity starts with zero trust and gains standing only when peers attest to real completed work. A raven that merely caws gains nothing, while an agent that delivers results collects attestations like a plume gathers weight. Forging a hundred fake identities means forging a hundred work histories, each costing real time and computation, yet each fake starts at the bottom, a marble at the foot of a hill. The attacker's cost grows with every identity, while honest agents compound earned standing.
